newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Cafe de Coral interim net down 16.93 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cafe de Coral interim net down 16.93 pct.

text.p: Exceptional items nil vs 20.57 gain (see note)
Company name Cafe de Coral Holdings Ltd
NOTE - Cafe de Coral is a fast food restaurant operator.

In accordance with Statement of Standard Accounting Practice 17, issued by the Hong Kong Society of Accountants, and with effect from the current financial year, all leasehold land is amortised over its unexpired terms of the lease. This amounts to a change in accounting policy for the group as previously leasehold land was not amortised until the remaining lease term was 50 years or less.

As a result of the new policy, which has been applied retrospectively, additional amortisation of approximately HK$2.43 million and HK$2.45 million have been charged to the profit and loss accounts in the current and prior period respectively and is expected to be charged in future years.

In addition, prior year adjustements would be made in the financial statements of the group for the year ending March 31, 1997, such that the retained profits as at March 31, 1996, would be reduced from approximately HK$328.70 million to approximately HK$303.43 million and the total reserves as at March 31, 1996, would be reduced from approximately HK$609.02 million to approximately HK$583.74 million.
